column3: bash -c for f in /etc/ssh/sshd_config /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/*.conf; do [ -f "$f" ] && { echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; }; done
bash -c fail2ban-client status && fail2ban-client status sshd
bash -c for f in /etc/apt/preferences /etc/apt/preferences.d/*; do [ -f "$f" ] && { echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; }; done
bash -c dpkg-query -W -f="\${Package} \${Status}\n" unattended-upgrades; apt-config dump | grep -E "^(APT::Periodic|Unattended-Upgrade::)"; systemctl is-enabled apt-daily-upgrade.timer
bash -c ls -ld /var/log/journal 2>&1; systemd-analyze cat-config systemd/journald.conf 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^[[:space:]]*Storage"

bash -c ps -eo user,pid,args --no-headers | grep -iE "[j]upyter|[n]otebook|[c]ode-server|[l]ambda|[c]loudflared" | sed -E "s/(token|password)=[^ ]*/\1=REDACTED/Ig"; systemctl list-unit-files --no-legend --no-pager | grep -iE "[j]upyter|[l]ambda|[c]ode-server|[c]loudflared"
bash -c for f in /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*; do [ -f "$f" ] && { echo "=== $f"; grep -vE "^[[:space:]]*(#|$)" "$f"; }; done
